Population counts per group

Source: R/stats.R
stat_big_n.Rd

Counts distinct subjects per treatment group, for "N=xx" column headers.

Usage

stat_big_n(
  df,
  trt_var,
  id_var = "USUBJID",
  total = TRUE,
  total_label = "Total"
)

Arguments

df

Data frame.

trt_var

Treatment/grouping column. Group order follows factor levels when it is a factor, otherwise sorted values.

id_var

Subject identifier column.

total

Add a total column?

total_label

Name of the total column.

Value

Named integer vector, one element per group (plus the total).

Examples

stat_big_n(ex_adsl, "TRT01A")
#> Drug 10 mg Drug 20 mg    Placebo      Total 
#>         20         20         20         60
